verdict.rationale: Each connection is configured through a Settings message that carries the agent block, so per-call system prompts can be supplied at session start. A conversation-context page documents the levers for managing context, including mid-call InjectAgentMessage. However, the evidence shows no first-class dynamic-variable or templating mechanism for per-caller data, so personalization relies on the developer building prompts per call. Missing for 10: documented dynamic variable/template substitution, explicit per-caller context injection (e.g., caller metadata into prompts or reusable configs), and examples or independent corroboration of personalized calls.
